fusions.name: Cold Compress
fusions.desc: Your next strike deals 7 damage, gives the target [Frostbite] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds and slows it by 20% for 2 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Sullen Chill
fusions.desc: Breathes a cold draught in a cone 4 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage to everything caught in it and stunning it for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stilled Weft
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Mended Tail
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 50%, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 45 seconds.
